newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia subsidises tourist flights to Dubrovnik.
newsitem.headline: Croatia subsidises tourist flights to Dubrovnik.

text.p: Croatia signed an agreement on Wednesday with the state air carrier Croatia Airlines pledging more subsidies on flights to Dubrovnik on the Adriatic Sea in an effort to help tourist trade.
Minister Niko Bulic told a news conference this year's aid for all forms of travel to coastal resorts would total 30 million kuna ($4.9 million). Of this 25 percent was to enable cheaper flights.
"May figures showed strong increases in all (tourist) areas, but not for the Dubrovnik county... Hence the need to help that southern part of the coast," Bulic said.
The deal is aimed at reducing the commercial risk of the airline on regular and chartered flights, particularly from Germany and Austria.

Domestic flights to Dubrovnik with a minimum stay of seven nights will also be 30 percent cheaper in June 16-September 14 high season. The same discount applies to four-day return flights in the off-season between April and mid-December.
-- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 6.106 Croatian Kuna)
